function.name: get_game_results
function.description: Retrieve game results between two teams on a specific date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The date of the game in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most recognizable names who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey—both past legends and recent stars:

| Era | Notable Players |
|-----|-----------------|
| **Early years (1970s‑80s)** | *Moses Malone*, *Kenny Smith*, *Bobby Phills* |
| **1990s** | *Gary Payton*, *Chris Webber*, *Julius Erving* (short stint) |
| **2000s (pre‑2010)** | *Blake Griffin*, *DeAndre Jordan*, *Chris Paul* (first stint), *Jamal Crawford* |
| **2010s (post‑2010)** | *Paul George*, *Kawhi Leonard*, *Reggie Jackson*, *Julius Randle*, *Jae Crowder* |
| **Recent seasons (2020‑present)** | *Paul George*, *Kawhi Leonard*, *Julius Randle*, *Jae Crowder*, *Jalen Green*, *Cameron Johnson*, *Rudy Gobert* (brief stint), *Gordon Hayward* (short stint) |

### Current (2025‑26) roster highlights  
(As of the latest preseason lineup)

- **Paul George** – All‑Star forward, franchise cornerstone.  
- **Kawhi Leonard** – Defensive stalwart & two‑time Finals MVP.  
- **Julius Randle** – Power forward/center, versatile scorer.  
- **Jae Crowder** – Veteran wing, known for his defensive intensity.  
- **Jalen Green** – Young guard, explosive scorer.  
- **Cameron Johnson** – Emerging guard, solid playmaker.  

These lists aren’t exhaustive—many other greats like *Derek Fisher*, *Danny Manning*, *Steve Nash* (short stint), *Julius Erving* (brief stint), *Gordon Hayward*, *Glen Rice*, *Michael Olowokandi*,
